searchResults.resultTitle: Rye & Rosemary Bakery — sourdough and pastry in Roscoe Village
searchResults.resultSnippet: Skip the Saturday line. Order Ahead and your bread is bagged, labeled with your name and waiting on the shelf behind the register when you walk in.
Order Ahead means we set your bread and pastry aside before the door opens, so it cannot sell out from under you. Here is how it works.
Rye & Rosemary Bakery is owned by Sofia Marchetti, who is also the head baker. We have one shop, at 27 Example Street, Chicago, IL 60657.
